title: Verify issue #2284 is resolved in staging/production
body: The fix was merged on 2026-05-31 but issue was opened on 2026-06-01, suggesting QA tested an outdated environment. Verify the '7th-grade-prep-math' product page now shows 'Unnamed item' (or correct lesson titles/feature keys) instead of '[object Object]'.
rationale: Issue was likely filed based on stale QA data from an environment not yet redeployed with the fix.
